statement.text: Problem Let $\mathcal{X}$ be an indexed family of filters on sets. Which of the below items are always pairwise equal? 1. The funcoid corresponding to this function (considered as a single argument function on indexed families) applied to the reloidal product of filters $\mathcal{X}$. 2. The funcoid corresponding to this function (considered as a single argument function on indexed families) applied to the starred reloidal product of filters $\mathcal{X}$. 3. $\bigcap_{F\in\operatorname{up}^{\mathrm{FCD}}\prod^{\mathrm{Strd}}\mathcal{X}}\langle f \rangle F$.
